verdict.rationale: Anytype's docs say you can export content at any time, in Markdown or the native Any-Block format, and can export all your channels, framed as 'You can leave anytime. Your data goes with you.' Community complaints about opaque on-disk storage concern native storage, not export, so they do not contradict the export capability. Missing for 10: evidence of how faithfully Markdown export preserves databases, properties, relations and files; any other open formats such as CSV or JSON for structured data; independent hands-on corroboration of a full-knowledge-base export.
